points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean builds in network-disabled cfd-bench; no registered CTest tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Config/CLI, output and restart source present; exact historic binary remains unbound.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate mesh, partition, physics, reconstruction and solver files; 2-D focus remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver wrapper found; external authorship investigation not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Input case selects mesh and controls; multizone CGNS reader does not depend on two filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS owned/ghost distribution and neighbor exchange; tracked np1/2/4/8 steady comparison agrees closely.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity updates and guarded residual convergence exist; numerical accuracy differs across cases.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Recorded structural validation and rank studies exist; no registered CTests or grid/time convergence study.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular C++ and documented postprocessing; checkpoint retains raw outputs, although curated tip excludes them.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
